en.headline: Observatory expects showers and squally thunderstorms from Friday afternoon
en.dek: A special weather tip issued at 16:15 said an approaching upper-air disturbance would bring gradual showers from Friday afternoon, increasing with squally thunderstorms at night, and heavier rain at first on Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip on Thursday afternoon, saying that as an upper-air disturbance approaches, the recently fine weather will change.

The Observatory said it expected a few showers to develop gradually from Friday afternoon. Showers would increase at night with a few squally thunderstorms, and winds would strengthen. On Saturday, showers would be heavy at first.

Members of the public were advised to take note of the latest weather information from the Observatory and to be aware of weather changes during outdoor activities. With the upper-air disturbance moving away, showers would ease off during the day on Saturday, the weather would improve, and there would be sunny periods in the afternoon.
The tip was issued at 16:15 HKT on 12 November. No official weather warnings were in force at the time of the tip.

zh.headline: 天文台特別提示：周五下午起有駆雨 晚上有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台於16時15分發出特別天氣提示，指高空擾動靠近，預料周五下午開始逐漸有幾陣駆雨，晚上駆雨增多及有幾陣狂風雷暴，周六初時雨勢頗大。
body: 香港天文台周四下午發出特別天氣提示，表示隨著高空擾動靠近，本港近期較晴朗的天氣將會有所改變。
天文台預料，周五下午開始逐漸有幾陣駆雨，晚上駆雨增多及有幾陣狂風雷暴，風勢增強。星期六初時雨勢頗大。
市民請留意天文台的最新天氣消息，進行戶外活動時亦要時刻注意天氣變化。隨著高空擾動遠離，星期六日間駆雨減少，天色好轉，下午部分時間有陽光。
提示於11月12日16時15分發出。當時並無其他官方天氣警告生效。
